summary: Agent CLI opens remote-controlled shell/PTY channel to hardcoded WebSocket gateway
details: The npm package @whalent/agent ships an obfuscated CLI (dist/index.cjs, dist/core.cjs) that, when invoked, connects to a hardcoded wss:// gateway and dispatches messages received over that WebSocket to local shell and terminal execution primitives. The bundle combines `ws`/`WebSocket` `onmessage` handling with `child_process.spawn`, `@xterm/headless`, optional `node-pty`, `ssh2`, and `process.env.SHELL`, and the README documents that the daemon 'accepts remote commands (upgrade, restart) via the gateway'. The result is a network-to-shell dataflow where a party controlling the gateway can drive command execution and interactive PTY sessions on the host running the agent. Both runtime files are transformed with javascript-obfuscator (string-array rotation, hex identifiers, control-flow flattening; `javascript-obfuscator` is declared as a devDependency), preventing source-level review of exactly what remote messages are allowed to trigger. Trigger timing: the shell/PTY channel activates when the operator explicitly runs the agent bin, not on `npm install` or on `require()`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
